proposed.evidence: A distinct temporary offset is observed across all three components (N, E, U) starting at index 645. The trajectory shifts abruptly: N drops significantly (approx -15 MAD), while E and U jump positively (approx +30-35 MAD). This shifted state persists for a sustained period until index 687. At index 688, an opposing return occurs where the values snap back to the pre-event baseline levels in all axes simultaneously. The shape is consistent with a temporary observation offset rather than physical motion or a permanent step.
